dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast, softened outer boundaries. The patterns exhibit a distinct gradient transition from the dark surrounding pelage to light-colored, semi-translucent interior regions, primarily clustered on the mid-to-upper dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, non-gradient pixel clusters. Visible mostly as small, isolated high-intensity white points situated on the upper cranial and snout regions, lacking the internal complexity of the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary, more linear spatial relationship is formed by the centroids of smaller annuli extending from the neck toward the posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent pinkish-red specular reflection (eye shine) within the right orbital cavity, contrasting with the dark ocular region.
